actions.title: Engro Fertilizers — H1 results confirmed weaker, dividend paid and ex-date passed; management upbeat on H2 demand
actions.detail: −6.4% on cost (Rs 186.12 today; position unchanged at 2,600 shares). Confirmed H1 2026 results (PSX filing, Jul 30): consolidated profit Rs 7.12B (-15.9%/-16% YoY), EPS Rs 5.33 (vs Rs 6.34) — standalone was worse, -34.6% YoY, EPS Rs 4.49 (vs Rs 6.87) — cushioned at the consolidated level by a one-off Rs 1.8B SIDC remeasurement gain that won't repeat. H1 revenue Rs 70.9B (-12% YoY). The board paid the interim dividend of Rs 1.75/share (ex-date Mon Aug 10, now passed), taking H1 total payout to Rs 3.75/share — yield intact. Management reiterated no plans to discount urea prices despite the ~694K ton glut, expects favorable H2 farmer economics to clear it and let EFERT hold its ~Rs 150/bag premium; debt expected to normalize by year-end as post-Rabi sales improve cash flow. No fresh news since — second straight half of declining core earnings, worth testing against Q3 numbers before rotating out.
